title: Extractor buffer rewind
statement: Let $x$ and $a$ be Boolean words, let $i \le |x|$, and let $j \le |a|$. For either choice of Boolean flags, the pair extractor started in rewind state with input head just past the first $i$ symbols of $x$, buffer $a$, work head at displacement $j-1$, and empty output reaches after exactly $j+1$ steps the configuration with replay state, the same input head and buffer, work head at $0$, and empty output.
replaced:
From the extractor's rewind state with buffer $a$ and work head at
displacement $j-1$, for any $j \le \abs{a}$, exactly $j+1$ steps return the
work head to displacement $0$ and enter the replay state, with the input
position, the buffer, and the (empty) output unchanged.
